szenen.vo: [intense] Look at the five people you spend the most time with. Really look at them.
[intense] Because that's who you're becoming, whether you like it or not.
[intense] If they laugh at your goals and drain your energy, you'll end up empty.
[intense] If they push you, you'll go further than you ever thought you could.
[shouting] So choose your circle like your future depends on it. Because it does!
[intense] And if that means being alone for a while? That's okay.
[shouting] Find the people who make you better, and level up!
